newsitem.title: USA: Allied Capital to pay $0.38-shr special div.
newsitem.headline: Allied Capital to pay $0.38-shr special div.

text.p: Allied Capital Corp said it will pay a special dividend of $0.38 per share at the end of the year.

The dividend is in addition to the company's regular quarterly dividend of $0.31 a share for the fourth quarter, the company said, adding that for 1996 it will pay a total of $1.51 a share in dividends.
The company did not say specifically on what date it would pay the dividend or provide other information.
Officials at the company were not immediately available to comment.
The company has about 7.2 million share outstanding.
